title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Determination of the Place of Performance of a Purchase and Sale Contract in Determining Jurisdiction over Economic Dispute Cases

articles.content_en:
1. Where the parties expressly agree on a place of performance in the contract, the agreed place of performance shall be the place of performance of the contract.
Where the parties do not expressly agree on a place of performance in the contract, the agreed place of delivery shall be the place of performance of the contract.
The place of arrival of goods, the place of arrival at the station, the place of inspection, the place of installation and commissioning, etc., as agreed in the contract, shall not be deemed as the place of performance of the contract.

2. Where the parties expressly agree on a place of performance or place of delivery in the contract, but change the agreement in writing or in any other manner unanimously recognized by both parties during actual performance, the place of performance of the contract shall be determined in accordance with the changed agreement. Where the parties do not change the original agreement in the aforesaid manner, or change the original contract without addressing the issue of the place of performance, the place of performance shall still be determined in accordance with the original contract.

3. Where the parties do not agree on or have an unclear agreement on the place of performance or place of delivery in the contract, or where there is an agreement but the goods are not actually delivered, and the domiciles of both parties are not in the agreed place of performance, as well as disputes over oral purchase and sale contracts, the jurisdiction of the case shall not be determined based on the place of performance.
Where the previous judicial interpretations of this Court concerning the place of performance of purchase and sale contracts are inconsistent with these Provisions, these Provisions shall prevail.
September 12, 1996
